subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the set and painting-style reference: a quiet dusty country road in ancient China in summer, a melon field with big round green striped watermelons on leafy vines on one side, one plum tree full of purple plums beside a low earth wall, soft distant hills, painted in Chinese ink wash on aged rice paper.

summary:
A scene from an animated Chinese ink-wash storybook retelling an ancient story. Animated traditional Chinese ink-wash painting (shuimo) on warm aged rice paper: loose expressive black ink brushstrokes, soft grey washes, lots of open space, muted earthy colors. It looks like a hand-painted storybook coming to life, with gentle painterly motion. Characters are stylized painted figures.

retention_analysis:

detailed_description:
Very wide, calm view of the country road, the melon field and the single plum tree at golden hour: the upper half of the frame is open pale sky; leaves sway gently in the wind. Nobody in the scene. Static camera. The composition is clean and simple: plain ground, clear calm air, only the characters and objects described. Natural, unhurried, physically plausible motion; everyone stays fully inside the frame in one continuous shot. Animated traditional Chinese ink-wash painting (shuimo) on warm aged rice paper: loose expressive black ink brushstrokes, soft grey washes, lots of open space, muted earthy colors. It looks like a hand-painted storybook coming to life, with gentle painterly motion. Characters are stylized painted figures.
